surfaces.says: Codex reads AGENTS.md at the repository root as project instructions, and one agent definition per TOML file under .codex/agents/ -- name, description and developer_instructions as strings. Taken from the product's documentation; a claim until a run of the product is observed reading what was served. It reads hooks at .codex/hooks.json (events pre_tool_use / post_tool_use, matcher apply_patch); the event names are measured by inspection of codex-cli 0.153.2 and post_write_block is proven by receipt on a prior hand-built system, but every tool_input.* key and the patch grammar in `hands` are UNVERIFIED -- ordered so a wrong guess misses (and the judge then refuses as unjudged) rather than mis-binds. Codex has NOT proven pre_exec_block, so the judge is wired AFTER the write: a refusal there flags the change to the model, it does not prevent it (ADR-017 decision 5).
